title: Agamemnon's Return and Murder

scope.description: Agamemnon returns to Mycenae, is murdered, and Electra saves Orestes.

Clytemnestra feigned the greatest joy on beholding her husband, and in spite of the urgent warnings of Cassandra, who was now a captive in his train, he received her protestations of affection with the most trusting confidence.
During the massacre of the retainers of Agamemnon which followed, his daughter Electra, with great presence of mind, contrived to save her young brother Orestes.
